mainEntity.name: What kind of tenants are typically attracted to rental ADUs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rental ADUs often appeal to single professionals, young couples, students, or individuals seeking more affordable and private living spaces compared to larger apartments or houses. The unique living arrangement offers a blend of independence and a connection to a residential neighborhood. When planning, consider including amenities such as dedicated entrances, compact but full kitchens, and sufficient storage to cater to this tenant demographic.
acceptedAnswer.description: ADUs attract single professionals, young couples, and students seeking affordable, private living; designing with dedicated entrances and full amenities can appeal to them.
